description: Tolerances to use when comparing a trace with a golden trace. The unit of a value is determined from the suffix of its key (e.g. position_mm is in millimeters); a value matches if it differs from the golden value by at most abs + rel * |golden value|. Integers without a unit (colors, timestamps in milliseconds, flags, counts and event fields) must match exactly. Values in scale units (_units) are compared to within one unit, since implementations may quantize coordinates differently by one unit; integer values computed with powf() or logf() (_approx8) are compared to within one, since math libraries may differ by an amount that changes the truncated value.
